_doc: Named acknowledgements for scripts/honest-ratchet.py. A decrease or removal in the kit's protective state (tests per suite, test names, rules/ files, protect-test-config patterns, guard/check scripts, CI jobs) passes --check ONLY under an entry here that names it exactly. Count item: {"item": "pytest:tests/test_x.py", "base": <old>, "new": <new>, "reason": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"} -- BOTH counts exact. Member item: {"item": "<set>::<member>", "reason": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. An entry missing reason or an ISO date is ignored. Written by a human reviewer who read the loss, never by the agent that caused it.
